Name: Reedy edge
Description: Waves lapping through a belt of reeds onto a pond's muddy edge (ShoreSpec.ReedShore, ShoreSynth): the stems take most of the waves before they arrive. Its box is the stretch of edge it stands for: X its length along the edge, Z the fetch, how far the water reaches straight out from it; turn the entity so its +Z faces the water. Silent in a calm. Not a recording and not a loop.
